description: Moving averages edge cases: (1) period==1 — output equals input for both SMA and EMA (alpha=2/(1+1)=1.0, so EMA instantly tracks price); (2) period==len — single output value equal to SMA of all closes; (3) flat input — SMA and EMA both equal the constant price; (4) dispatcher case-insensitive routing — 'sma'/'SMA'/'ema'/'EMA' all route correctly.

cases.name: period-equals-one
cases.description: period=1: alpha=1, so EMA=closes and SMA=closes

cases.name: period-equals-length
cases.description: period==len: single value = mean of all = 5.0

cases.name: flat-input
cases.description: flat prices: SMA=5.0 everywhere, EMA=5.0 everywhere

cases.name: dispatcher-case-insensitive
cases.description: all four case variants must route without error
